resources.string: Status: GRANTED (helper authorized to invoke RunCommandService)
Status: NOT GRANTED (grant required for cold-boot dispatch)

1. Termux external apps configuration:
 Add allow-external-apps=true to ~/.termux/termux.properties.
 Security note: Grant RUN_COMMAND permission ONLY to this bounded helper.

2. Xiaomi MIUI background settings:
 - Autostart: ENABLED for Termux and AIOS Boot Bootstrap.
 - Battery saver: NO RESTRICTIONS for both apps.

3. Bootstrap script deployment:
 Ensure start-services.sh is deployed to:
 ~/.aios-node/bootstrap/start-services.sh

4. Physical cold-boot verification:
 Reboot the device to complete physical qualification. Source completion alone does not mark N4 PASS.
